_note: The fixed opening cluster (DESIGN.md "Fixed opening cluster", M9.1): placed first and identical on every seed. Positions are metres from home's centre (dx east, dz south); home sits on the cliff at config.map.cluster.homeX. key: an encounter id from encounters.json, or a sigil ground id from sigilGrounds.json with kind "sigilGround". clearingType: homeWoods keeps checkpoint and roadside mixes out of the cluster, so its sigils raise citizens (Session 11). paths: the cluster's pathways (the only ones north of the cordon); the frontier joins at the outpost alone, through the checkpoint. They make a loop, so the dead and the witch reach the shelter side without walking through the station. road: true = this pathway follows the road. road.points: the road's control points (dx, dz from home), west edge to the checkpoint; it passes the gas station's forecourt about 14 m south of the clearing's centre (the station building goes north of it, M9.3) and runs through the outpost and due south through the checkpoint. road.wrecks: the fixed cars on it (along: metres from the west end; side: metres right (+) or left (-) of the centre line; turn: radians off the road's heading; type from vehicles.json). Their batteries and alarms are rolled per run like any car's. gates: the soft-gated path order (DESIGN.md): each blocks Tom (only) on its path until its progress flag (data/progress.json) is set. path + at (metres from the first clearing's centre) or t (fraction along); or road (metres along the road); kind: pipeGate, fallenTree, chainGate, or checkpoint (the cordon's, drawn with the cordon). locked: what Tom finds when he walks into it shut.
